_meta.note: T-60 layer 2. Policy + lock -> accept or reject. Every `expect` is written by hand from the policy as specified; nothing here is derived from an implementation. A refused lock has exactly one fault, except in a step marked `twoFaults`, where every reader names the earlier one: all three check in one order. `target` and `signer` are symbolic: each reader resolves them against its own rig. Each reader runs the cases that name it and asserts it ran `counts[reader]`.
